#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Differential test: reference executable vs. the Node.js port.
# Compares stdout, stderr and exit status for every argument vector.
# The reference is a PyInstaller build, so its nondeterministic
# "[PYI-<pid>:ERROR] ..." trailer is filtered out of stderr before comparing.

REF=/workspace/dataset/test8_executable

pass=0

  "$REF" "$@" >/tmp/ref.out 2>/tmp/ref.err; rc_ref=$?
  node /output/test8.mjs "$@" >/tmp/js.out 2>/tmp/js.err; rc_js=$?
  grep -v '^\[PYI-[0-9]*:ERROR\]' /tmp/ref.err > /tmp/ref.err.f

  if [ "$rc_ref" != "$rc_js" ] \
     || ! cmp -s /tmp/ref.out /tmp/js.out \
     || ! cmp -s /tmp/ref.err.f /tmp/js.err; then
